name: qa_usbdisk_chord_shift_f1
title: OS-USBDISK U1d, QA-GLB-016: power on holding Shift + F1 only: no disk mode

steps.say: OS-USBDISK U1d, row QA-GLB-016, case shift_f1: hold Shift + F1 only while powering the unit on, then start this run. Nothing is injected, nothing is written

steps.note: the chord was read and is not the disk chord
a normal boot: the Tracker owns the card (a card in the slot is mounted)
